records.description: Hello, One Fullerton! Since landing at Jewel Changi in 2019, we’ve been growing our Shack family across the island—and now, we’re fired up to open our 11th Shack! This new Shack at One Fullerton is serving up more than just burgers—it’s got front-row seats to some of the best views in town. Think Marina Bay Sands, the Singapore Flyer, and that picture-perfect skyline. The space brings a breezy, coastal-inspired feel with subtle nods to Singapore’s vibrant culture. But what are we really excited about? Our exclusive Concrete collab with a true local gem—Mrs Kueh. About the artwork in our Shack Say hello to the wild side of the Shack. Local artist Sadiq Mansor splashes his signature style across our walls with an artwork inspired by creatures native to Singapore—reimagined with a magical twist for our Mythical Tide theme. From the shy pangolin to the rare pink dolphin and the majestic sambar deer, Sadiq brings these animals to life like you’ve never seen before. Think coral-crowned otters, tidal-winged hornbills, and glowing, deep-sea crabs—all vibing in a dreamy world where land meets sea and myth meets reality. Known for his bold characters and playful storytelling, Sadiq turns the everyday into the extraordinary. His mural is a celebration of Singapore’s rich biodiversity, brought to life with color, curiosity, and a whole lot of Shack spirit. One Pineapple Please We’ve teamed up with Mrs Kueh to create a Shack-exclusive dessert that blends our vanilla frozen custard with her signature Pineapple and Citrus tart—a buttery, golden classic with sweet, tangy pineapple jam. It’s rich, refreshing, and a perfect bite of nostalgia in every spoonful. It’s our way of giving a little nod to heritage flavours while mixing things up in a fun, new way. As part of our Stand For Something Good mission, we love teaming up with local partners who put heart into what they do—just like Mrs Kueh. They’re known for their handmade, traditional kuehs, and together we’ve created a Concrete that’s a little unexpected yet a little nostalgic. It’s our way of celebrating the local community we’re proud to be part of. See you soon at the Shack!

records.description: National Cheeseburger Day National Cheeseburger Day If there’s one day on the calendar that feels made for us, it’s the National Cheeseburger Day. Afterall, we’ve been putting our spin on the great American cheeseburger since 2004 with the ShackBurger And what’s a better way to celebrate than with extra beef? From 14 – 18 September, celebrate National CheeseBurger day with a FREE Beef Patty add-on* with any ShackBurger or SmokeShack purchase via the Happy Point app. The Cheeseburger Formula The cheeseburger has earned its place as an American classic with a simple formula: beef, cheese, bun and toppings. But when something is made up of just a few ingredients, every one of them matters. So, what makes a great cheeseburger? Let’s break down the basics. Real Beef For us, a good cheeseburger starts with the beef. That’s why our beef patties are made to order with 100% Angus beef. Each quarter-pound beef patty is smashed to order, seasoned, seared and cheesed to bring together the rich, beefy flavor and juicy texture that fans know and love. Real Classic We believe in keeping good things simple. So when it came to our version of the great American cheeseburger, reinvention wasn’t really on the agenda. Getting it right was. While it sounds simple, getting simple right actually took years of tinkering, tweaking and plenty of tasting before we landed on the ShackBurger, a classic in its own right that continues to let the beef speak for itself. Now that you know the beef, come taste it for yourself! How to redeem: Tap on ‘Order’ Select a ShackBurger / SmokeShack Select Double – the second patty’s automatically on us! records.description: Meet Our Collab Partners Meet the artist! Introduction I am a Singaporean visual artist illustrating my way through sprawling wall murals and artist-brand collaborations. My artworks are often bold, striking and inspired by traditional Asian motifs with playful nuance that reflects both my heritage and personality. Inspiration The main inspiration from this collaboration stems from Singapore’s heritage and iconic orchid to create something that feels traditional with a modern twist from with my art lens and style. Why work with Shake Shack Ever since the Great World Shake Shack opening, I’ve always been grateful to Shake Shack for giving me a chance to be the 6th local artist to adorn the Shack, as a young artist back then and an older artist now. Working with Shake Shack offers a unique opportunity to blend creativity with community connection. As an artist, it’s inspiring to collaborate with a brand that values local voices and vibrant storytelling. Their willingness to embrace local culture and support creative expression makes them an ideal partner for any artist looking to make a positive, lasting impact. Favorite food from the limited time offer menu As a die hard fan of the 50/50, the Buah Long Long lemonade is an easy favorite for me! His Work In celebration of Singapore culture, we’ve teamed up with local artist tobyato to design an exclusive range of merchandise. Known for his bold and illustrative designs often inspired by Asian motifs, did you know that he’s also painted our mural at Great World Shack, 2021? This time, he has designed a collaborative emblem in tribute to familiar local icons from orchids to Peranakan tiles, which will adorn enamel mugs, scarves, t-shirts and even tiffin carriers, otherwise known as tingkats. The chefs behind the Zi Char inspired menu! Introduction We are a family-run Zi Char restaurant in Singapore, known for its rich heritage and hearty, wok-fried dishes. With over 50 years of history, KEK has become a local icon, serving up signature dishes like the famous Moonlight Hor Fun and Chilli Crab. This Michelin Guide-recommended spot is celebrated for its authentic flavors, warm hospitality, and a legacy that spans three generations, making it a go-to destination for food lovers seeking the true taste of Singapore. Inspiration Our origin dates back to Hainan, China learning all the Chinese dishes from our 1st generation. After 3 generations, we evolved very much to our Singaporean culture getting inspired by our local palette yet staying true to heritage. Why work with Shake Shack Not just a regular burger joint. Quality and value had been very similar to KEK, with the philosophy of people first. Favorite food from the Zi Char inspired menu Tough one here honestly, can we say all? If we need to pick : Wayne: White Pepper Beef 🍔 Paul: Coffee-glazed Chicken 🍔 Here’s a little treat! Get complimentary White pepper fries* on us when you put your knowledge about our local collab to the test, click here to find out!
